title: Green Turtle Grove Carriage – 30A Beach Properties
description_expanded:
30-A Beach Properties presents Green Turtle Grove Carriage in Rosemary Beach - a newly renovated and award-winning Coastal Retreat. Our superb location on Boardwalk F leads you directly to the clear gulf waters. The Rosemary Beach Town Center and cafes are one block away. Green Turtle Grove carriage comfortably sleeps four in beds, a lovely new kitchen, and a gulf view peak from wrap around upper balcony.

*** SLEEPS 12 WITH MAIN HOUSE (separate fee).

Tucked beneath a grove of mature coastal trees, and moments from the sugar-white sands of the Gulf, Green Turtle Grove is a beautifully renovated Rosemary Beach retreat designed for gathering, relaxing, and creating memories with family and friends. This clean and fresh carriage is the perfect place for up to four guests to enjoy the beach! One garage parking space is provided.

Features

· Two-story Carriage House comfortably sleeps 4 with 1 Queen bedroom and Loft with 2 Twin beds.

- Ideally situated directly on Rosemary Beach’s iconic Boardwalk F

· Effortless 1-2 minute stroll to the sugar-white sands of the Gulf

· Gulf views from wrap around balcony

- Keurig and Drip Coffee Makers

- New Washer/Dryer just outside kitchen

- All new appliances

· Just steps (1 min walk) to Main Street & Barrett Square’s boutiques, cafés, and dining

· Freshly renovated with refined finishes and thoughtful coastal design

· Private outdoor hot & cold showers, perfect after beach days

· Charming courtyard seating for morning coffee or evening gatherings, including a grilling area

· Green Turtle Grove Cottage is also available to Rent for Additional Space

- Sony Smart Tv's

· One Dedicated Parking Space in the Garage

· Winner of Southern Living magazine “Southern Home Award”

CARRIAGE HOUSE: Sleeps 4 with 3 beds, 1.5 bathrooms, dedicated private hot/cold outdoor shower

1st FLOOR: Primary bedroom: Queen bed, ensuite bathroom with shower

2nd FLOOR: Loft: 2 Twin beds Powder room – half bath
